_comment: Relics (GDD §10). Passive permanent modifiers, one per elite kill (choice of two) plus Market purchases. These are the eight §10 authors by name, so none of them is invented here. Every relic carries a real drawback and the parser refuses one that does not: §10 is explicit that a pure upgrade creates a known-correct relic ranking, which is exactly the meta this design exists to avoid. A relic is data naming registered atoms (docs/M2_PLAN.md D39); the atoms are code, and an atom nobody has registered is a real design change rather than a silent extension point.

relics.name: Metronome
relics.gain: your first action each encounter costs 0 Weight
relics.drawback: and every action after it costs 1 more

relics.name: Undertow
relics.gain: Stagger you apply lasts 1 tick longer

relics.name: Prospector's Eye
relics.gain: elites drop a material one tier higher
relics.drawback: and all gold is cut by a fifth

relics.name: Prism
relics.drawback: and Ascendant tags only rise to 1.15

relics.name: Zealot's Blinders
relics.drawback: and Saturation climbs to 50% instead of 30%

relics.name: Bone Ledger
relics.gain: socket attempts cost 4% less Max HP
relics.drawback: and a failure Scars a second card as well

relics.name: Second Wind
relics.gain: the Guard action draws 2 cards instead of 1
